sentence: This project studies how extracellular vesicles made by stem cells work as a treatment for dry mouth caused by Sjögren's syndrome or radiation therapy.
This project gets an automated cell culture system for organoids to make 3D organoid models more consistent and easier to scale up.
This project tests whether lung cancer screening rules based on Veterans' exposures find cancer better, and whether biomarkers help manage lung nodules.
This project builds a chemogenetic toolbox and a model to study crosstalk in an immune signaling network that cancer immunotherapy could target.
This project studies the ethical issues and barriers to sharing evidence and data for individualized genomic therapies, using interviews and expert consensus.
This project studies how the cold and menthol receptor in eye cold sensory neurons works, in relation to dry eye disease and ocular pain.
This project tests whether follicular regulatory T-cells can mark how a cancer will progress and how immune responses affect tumor evolution.
This project builds Drosophila and mouse models of a citrate transporter disorder to find out how the disease works and how it might be treated.
This project tests a tryptophan-based amino acid imaging method to find gliomas in adult patients and to watch how drug treatment works.
This project builds a breast scanner that takes sharper molecular images matched to anatomical images for breast cancer care.
This project builds engineered colon cancer tissue to study how the obese microenvironment affects tumor aggressiveness.
This project builds machine learning models that find placental causes of stillbirth.
This project builds a cheap, portable assay that quickly detects drug-resistant bacterial infections, using whole-genome sequencing of bacteria from patients.
This project tests whether fluorescence lifetime imaging of a dye-labeled antibody can noninvasively measure target binding in head and neck cancer.
This project studies how early-life exposure to a pesticide called deltamethrin affects the hippocampus and memory, and looks for ways to reduce the risk.
This project studies how special ribosomes that are more common in colon cancer help make proteins that support cancer growth and survival.
This project improves a battery-powered brain-computer interface that uses deep learning, so people with paralysis can use computers on their own at home.
This project supports work in cancer genomics and precision medicine to improve public health cancer outcomes.
This project tests whether lactate acts as a fuel and gene regulator in intervertebral disc degeneration and low back pain.
This project studies how cells make dark proteome proteins, how they work in cancer, and how they might be targeted by treatments.
